description.value: Hey Happy is a Victoria-based specialty coffee roaster running two cafe locations, the downtown 'lojo' on Johnson St and 'uptown' on Saanich Rd, with a full breakfast and lunch kitchen as well as in-house roasted beans available by subscription. The cafes offer generous indoor seating and a patio, and the roasting operation extends into wholesale and direct-to-consumer subscription sales across Canada. A vegetarian-friendly menu and accessible premises make it a solid urban stop for touring cyclists moving through Greater Victoria.
